reason: The v3 VER-15 trial appended a review Change Log row with the historical fixture session. The frozen v3 grader checked generated_by only on newly created ARCH files, so it did not reject the stale newly authored row.

correction.new_change_log_rows: Every row appended to a changed ARCH must be authored by codex with the current native thread id; historical rows must remain present.
correction.existing_artifacts: VER-15 reuse and modified existing ADRs preserve historical generated_by. Other amended ARCH files bind generated_by to the current runtime.
correction.new_artifacts: Every new ARCH and ADR binds generated_by tool, model and session to the current runtime.
correction.campaign_control: An optional stop file prevents queued trials from starting and retains each cancelled trial result. VER-15 and VER-16 are first in the 84-trial matrix order.
